metaTitle: Custom Jersey Sweaters & Cardigans | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom jersey sweaters and cardigans for your team. Soft, breathable fabric perfect for layering. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Jersey knit sweaters and cardigans offer a soft, breathable alternative to traditional wool or acrylic knits. The smooth texture and slight stretch make them comfortable for all-day wear, whether your team is in the office, at a trade show, or on a casual outing. These garments take embroidery and screen printing cleanly, so your logo or message stands out without distortion. Choose jersey when you want a polished but relaxed look that layers easily over button-downs or polos.
heroAltText: Custom jersey sweaters and cardigans in various colors with embroidered logos, displayed on models in office and outdoor settings.
